name: widget-presets
title: Annotated presets
description: Rows of preset buttons for any widget; the chosen preset's one-line note says why it is worth trying.

selectFirst.description: Start every preset row with its first preset selected (and, for declarative rows, sent to the target).

noteLabel.description: Short text shown before each note, e.g. "Why:". Empty = no label.

eventName.description: Name of the CustomEvent a declarative row dispatches on its target element.

fillFields.description: Before a declarative row dispatches its event, write an object value into the target's data-field / name controls (each gets input and change events).
